Warm key light from camera-left with a bright rim light along the glossy highlights and deep soft shadows. Photorealistic cinematic food photograph from one fixed front view, the camera looking down at about 40 degrees, 85mm macro lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the food, the plate centred and large, filling the frame from edge to edge.
